## Automated Tests Required

**This sprint adds no new automated tests.** Rationale: launch prep introduces zero new gameplay logic. The 324-test suite at v0.53 is the regression safety net; it must pass on fresh clone (L-005 verifies this).

**One pre-launch verification command (L-005)**:

```bash
cd /tmp && rm -rf night-market-fresh && \
  git clone <repo-url> night-market-fresh && \
  cd night-market-fresh/src && \
  /Users/arlong/Downloads/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot \
    --headless -s addons/gut/gut_cmdln.gd \
    -gdir=res://tests -ginclude_subdirs -gexit
```

**Pass criteria**: 324/324 tests pass, no parse errors, no skipped tests. Log to `production/qa/smoke-2026-05-30-v1.0.md`.

**If any test fails on fresh clone but passes on local dev machine**: hidden environment dependency exists → BLOCK L-007 (v1.0 tag) until resolved.

## Manual QA Checklist

### L-001 — Web Build & Cross-Browser Verify (Integration)

**Verification method**: Manual playthrough on 2 browsers
**Who must sign off**: self (solo dev acts as own QA lead)
**Evidence to capture**: `production/qa/smoke-2026-05-30-v1.0.md` with browser/version, build size, and screenshot of title screen on each browser

Checklist:
- [ ] `godot --export-release "Web" exports/web/index.html` produces `index.html`, `.wasm`, `.pck`, `.png`
- [ ] Total `exports/web/` directory size **<20 MB** (note size in MB)
- [ ] Chrome (latest, mid-range laptop): page loads without console error; title screen visible within 8s
- [ ] Chrome: title → click START → 小杰 spawns at home → walk to baker → buy bread → walk to mom → win screen
- [ ] Firefox (latest): same flow, page loads, no console error, gameplay reaches win screen
- [ ] Both browsers: window resize does not break canvas (DPR / aspect maintained)
- [ ] Both browsers: refresh after audio-unlock does not throw audio context error

### L-002 — Fresh Smoke Check (Integration)

**Verification method**: Single full playthrough touching every post-MVP feature
**Who must sign off**: self
**Evidence to capture**: `production/qa/smoke-2026-05-30-v1.0.md` (see Smoke Test Scope below)

Checklist (Post-MVP features added v0.10→v0.53):
- [ ] **街頭藝人 (v0.49)**: 月琴阿伯 audible/visible at market corner; "NT$2 tip" interaction triggers and deducts money
- [ ] **寵物追隨 (v0.50)**: rescued cat appears as follower at home cell; follows player one cell behind on movement
- [ ] **時段系統 (v0.51)**: as `session_time` advances, sky darkens AND lanterns glow (observe at least 2 time-state transitions)
- [ ] **抽獎攤 (v0.52)**: NT$10 box accepts up to 3 draws per run; free-ingredient outcome correctly adds to inventory
- [ ] **Web export (v0.53)**: head_include CSS applied; `tests/` and `addons/gut/` NOT present in `exports/web/` build artifacts
- [ ] **Core MVP loop** (regression): buy all 5 ingredients → return to mum → win scene with money + time
- [ ] **Money buffer**: end-of-run remaining money matches expected (start NT$200 − sum of purchases − tips − lottery)

### L-003 — itch.io 頁面素材包 (Visual/UI)

**Verification method**: Asset format + design sign-off
**Who must sign off**: self (acting as art director)
**Evidence to capture**: assets committed to `production/release/itch-io-page/` with manifest

Checklist:
- [ ] `cover.png` is exactly **630×500 px** (itch.io spec)
- [ ] **3–5 screenshots** captured from in-game Chrome session, each ≥1280×720 px, PNG
- [ ] **~10s gameplay GIF** shows core loop (move → buy → win); file size <5 MB for itch.io upload
- [ ] **English description** (~150 words) covers: what the game is, single-sitting length, browser-playable, free
- [ ] **Chinese description** (~150 字) 同等內容
- [ ] **Tags list** drafted: e.g. `2D`, `Pixel Art`, `Taiwan`, `Shopping`, `Wholesome`, `Short`, `HTML5`
- [ ] Each asset reviewed for: no UI debug overlays visible, no dev console open, no placeholder text

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify in `smoke-2026-05-30-v1.0.md` before tagging v1.0:

1. **Boot**: Web build loads in Chrome → title screen visible → no console error
2. **Core loop**: title → market → buy 1 ingredient → walk to next stall → buy → reach mum with 5/5 → win screen
3. **街頭藝人 (v0.49)**: tip interaction works; money deducted by NT$2
4. **寵物追隨 (v0.50)**: pet appears at home cell; follows on movement
5. **時段系統 (v0.51)**: sky/lantern change observed over session_time advance
6. **抽獎攤 (v0.52)**: 3 draws max enforced; outcome adds to inventory if free-ingredient
7. **Web export config (v0.53)**: `tests/` and `addons/gut/` excluded from build artifacts
8. **Restart**: from win scene, can return to title and start a new run (no state bleed)
9. **Cross-browser**: items 1, 2, 6, 8 also verified in Firefox
10. **Performance**: no frame stutter during lottery draw or win-scene transition

Run via `/smoke-check sprint` after L-001 produces a build.

## Definition of Done — Sprint 1

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria in `production/sprints/sprint-01.md` verified via this plan's checklist
- [ ] Smoke check `smoke-2026-05-30-v1.0.md` captures evidence for that story
- [ ] For L-005: 324/324 tests pass on fresh clone with log appended
- [ ] No new S1/S2 bugs introduced (none expected since no new gameplay code)
- [ ] Code reviewed (most stories have no code — review applies to README, patch notes, devlog drafts)
- [ ] Story status updated in `production/sprint-status.yaml` to `done` (via `/story-done` or manual edit)

**Sprint is DONE for Production → Polish gate when**:
- All Must Have (L-001 → L-007) marked done
- Smoke check shows PASS
- Web build present at `exports/web/` and verified
- itch.io upload completed by user (out-of-band; documented in devlog)
